title: 第0003章 仙茅破障初露锋芒第0004章 药徒出山青炎风波
content_zh:
林药尘并没有走得太远。他身无分文，身体虚弱，深入荒野无疑是自寻死路。他在后山外围找到了一个废弃的猎人窝棚，勉强能遮风挡雨，便暂时安顿下来。
接下来的几天，他一边熟悉体内那丝微弱的真气，尝试运转系统提及的《万古药尊诀》的基础法门——虽然只是最基础的呼吸吐纳，但对他而言，已是踏入修行之门。另一边，他仔细研究系统图鉴，寻找修复绝脉的线索。
【绝脉：先天经脉闭塞，无法汇聚天地灵气，难以修炼。修复方案：需以“仙茅”为主药，辅以“仙灵脾”，炼制“龙虎强筋汤”，方可初步打通闭塞经脉，奠定修炼基础。】
“仙茅……仙灵脾……”林药尘看着图鉴上这两种草药的描述，心中既有期待，又有压力。
仙茅，别名地棕、独茅、山党参。味辛，性温。归肾、肝、脾经。功能主治：补肾阳，强筋骨，祛寒湿。用于-阳-痿-精冷，筋骨痿软，腰膝冷痛，阳虚冷泻。
仙灵脾，又名淫羊藿。味辛、甘，性温。归肝、肾经。功能主治：补肾阳，强筋骨，祛风湿。用于-阳-痿-遗精，筋骨痿软，风湿痹痛，麻木拘挛。
这两种草药，在凡间也是较为常见的温补药材，但在八荒大陆，尤其是灵气枯竭的如今，想要找到年份足、药效好的，却并不容易。系统图鉴显示，仙茅在后山的阴坡峭壁处有分布，而仙灵脾则多生长在林下或灌丛中。
“必须先找到仙茅！”林药尘知道，绝脉是他最大的障碍，一日不修复，他就始终是个“废人”，随时可能被林啸天等人彻底扼杀。
这日清晨，林药尘早早醒来，感觉体内真气又凝实了几分，腐骨散的阴影彻底消散，精神焕发。他带上之前采集剩下的白鲜皮和仙鹤草，以及一根削尖的木棍防身，再次进入后山，按照系统地图的指引，寻找仙茅。
后山比之外围更为险峻，古木参天，藤蔓缠绕，地势起伏很大。林药尘现在的体力，攀爬峭壁极为吃力。他花费了整整一个上午，才在一处背阴的陡峭山坡上，发现了几簇长势特殊的植物。
这些植物高一尺左右，叶片皱缩，表面有纵棱，根茎圆柱形，表面褐色，质地坚硬。正是仙茅！
【检测到目标物品：仙茅（凡级），是否采集？】
“采集！”林药尘大喜，立刻动手挖掘。仙茅的根-茎是深入土壤，挖掘起来颇为费力。他正卖力地挖着，突然，头顶上方传来一阵碎石滚落的声音！
“不好！”林药尘心中警铃大作，猛地向旁边一滚！
“轰隆！”
一块磨盘大的石头从上方滚落，重重地砸在他刚才站立的位置，溅起一片尘土。
林药尘惊魂未定地抬头望去，只见峭壁上方，三个人探头探脑地向下张望，为首一人，正是林厉！旁边是林虎，还有另一个林家护卫打扮的人。
“哈哈哈！林药尘，你这废人命真大啊！居然还没死，还跑到后山来了！”林厉趴在崖边，嚣张地大笑，“省得我们到处找你了，你自己送上门来，那就别怪我们不客气了！”
林虎也狞笑道：“大哥，跟他废什么话？直接砸死他算了！家主已经下令将他逐出家门，他现在就是个流浪的野狗，死了也没人管！”
那名护卫也面露凶光，显然是被林厉收买，一起来做这杀人灭口的勾当。

林药尘心中一片冰冷。他猜得没错，林啸天果然不肯放过他！这几人显然是跟踪他而来，要在后山将他彻底除掉！
“林厉，林虎！”林药尘站起身，虽然心中愤怒，但语气却异常平静，他握紧了手中的木棍，“我林药尘与你们有何深仇大恨，你们要一而再，再而三地置我于死地？”
“哼，林药尘，你不用装可怜！”林厉冷笑，“你本来就是个废物，活着也是浪费家族资源！而且，你知道的太多了！”他话里有话，显然是指林药尘可能察觉到了林啸天下毒的秘密。
“既然你冥顽不灵，那就去死吧！”林厉一挥手，和林虎以及那名护卫一起，开始往下投掷石块！
一时间，大大小小的石块如同雨点般砸向林药尘！峭壁狭窄，无处躲藏，林药尘左支右绌，狼狈不堪。他只有药徒一重的修为，身体也远未恢复，如何能抵挡三个人的围攻？
“砰！”一块石头砸中了他的肩膀，顿时红肿一片。
“哎哟！”另一块石头砸中了他的小腿，剧痛钻心。
林药尘节节败退，眼看就要被逼下悬崖！绝境之中，他猛地瞥见脚边那株刚挖出来的仙茅！
仙茅！强筋骨，祛寒湿！系统说过，仙茅有破障之效！
“拼了！”林药尘眼中闪过一丝疯狂。他不再躲避，反而弯腰一把抓起那株仙茅，按照系统之前传授的激发药力的方法，将体内所有的真气都灌注到手掌之中，狠狠地挤压那株仙茅！
“给我破！”林药尘低吼一声，将挤压出的带有辛辣气息的汁液，猛地抹在自己的眼眶、太阳穴和胸口膻中穴！这是系统临时提示的、利用仙茅辛温之气刺激穴位、短时间内爆发潜力的法子，副作用极大，但对现在的他来说，是唯一的生机！
【仙茅药性激发！警告！宿主身体将承受巨大负荷！】
一股灼热的气流猛地从药力渗透的部位炸开，瞬间流遍全身！林药尘只觉得眼前一片赤红，肌肉贲张，力量如同山洪暴发般涌出！原本酸痛无力的手臂，此刻充满了爆炸性的力量！
“滚下去！”林药尘仰天咆哮一声，声音嘶哑如野兽。他猛地捡起地上的一块尖锐石头，看准一枚砸向他的较大石块，不仅不躲，反而迎着石块冲了上去，用尽全力将石头掷出！
“咻——！”
那石头如同弩箭般射出，带着凌厉的劲风，直奔崖顶的林厉而去！
content_en:
Lin Yaochen didn't go too far. He was penniless and weak, and heading into the wilderness was undoubtedly a recipe for death. He found an abandoned hunter's shack on the outskirts of the back mountain, which could barely provide shelter from the wind and rain, so he temporarily settled down.
In the next few days, while he became familiar with the weak zhenqi in his body, he tried to operate the basic method of the "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" mentioned in the system - although it was only the most basic breathing and breathing, for him, it was already the door to practice. On the other side, he carefully studied the system illustration, looking for clues to repair the broken veins.
[Jue Meridian: The innate meridians are blocked, unable to gather the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, making it difficult to practice. Repair plan: It is necessary to use "curculigo" as the main medicine, supplemented by "Xianlingpi", and refine "Longhu Qiangjin Decoction" to initially open up the blocked meridians and lay the foundation for cultivation. 】
"Curculigo... Xian Lingpi..." Lin Yaochen looked at the descriptions of these two herbs in the illustrated book, feeling both expectation and pressure in his heart.
Curculigo, also known as ground brown, single grass, and Codonopsis pilosula. It tastes pungent and is warm in nature. Returns to the kidney, liver and spleen meridians. Functions and Indications: Replenishing kidney yang, strengthening muscles and bones, and dispelling cold and dampness. Used for yang impotence, cold essence, flaccid muscles and bones, cold pain in the waist and knees, cold diarrhea due to yang deficiency.
Xianlingpi, also known as Epimedium. It tastes pungent, sweet, and warm in nature. Returns to the liver and kidney meridians. Functions and Indications: Replenishing kidney yang, strengthening muscles and bones, and dispelling rheumatism. Used for yang impotence, nocturnal emission, weakness of muscles and bones, rheumatic arthralgia, numbness and spasm.
These two herbs are also relatively common warming and tonic herbs in the mortal world, but in the Bahuang Continent, especially now that the spiritual energy is exhausted, it is not easy to find them that are old enough and have good efficacy. The system illustration shows that curculigo is distributed on the shady slopes and cliffs of the back mountains, while fairy spleen mostly grows in the understory or shrubs.
"We must find Curculigo first!" Lin Yaochen knew that the dead pulse was his biggest obstacle. If it was not repaired for one day, he would always be a "waste" and could be completely strangled by Lin Xiaotian and others at any time.
In the early morning of this day, Lin Yaochen woke up early and felt that the true energy in his body had become more solidified. The shadow of the rotten bone powder had completely dissipated, and he felt refreshed. He took the remaining white skin and agrimony that he had collected before, as well as a sharpened wooden stick for self-defense, and entered the back mountain again, following the guidance of the system map to look for curculigo.
The back mountain is more steep than the outer perimeter, with towering ancient trees, tangled vines, and great undulations. Lin Yaochen's current physical strength makes it extremely difficult to climb the cliff. It took him a whole morning to discover several clusters of plants with special growth on a steep and shady hillside.
These plants are about a foot tall, have wrinkled leaves with longitudinal ribs on the surface, and cylindrical rhizomes with a brown surface and a hard texture. It's Curculigo!
[Target item detected: Curculigo (ordinary level), do you want to collect it? 】
"Collect!" Lin Yaochen was overjoyed and immediately started digging. The roots and stems of curculigo go deep into the soil and are quite laborious to dig. He was digging hard when suddenly, there was a sound of gravel rolling down above his head!
"Not good!" Lin Yaochen's heart rang with alarm bells, and he rolled to the side suddenly!
"Boom!"
A stone as big as a millstone rolled down from above, hitting the spot where he had just been standing, throwing up a cloud of dust.
Lin Yaochen looked up in shock and saw three people looking down at the top of the cliff. The leader was Lin Li! Next to him was Lin Hu, and another person dressed as a Lin family guard.
"Hahaha! Lin Yaochen, what a waste of life you are! You're not dead yet, and you've even come to the back mountain!" Lin Li was lying on the edge of the cliff, laughing arrogantly, "Save us from looking for you everywhere, you brought it to your door yourself, then don't blame us for being rude!"
Lin Hu also smiled evilly and said: "Brother, what nonsense are you talking to him? Just smash him to death! The owner of the house has ordered him to be kicked out of the house. Now he is just a stray wild dog. No one will care about him even if he dies!"
The guard also had a fierce look on his face. He was obviously bribed by Lin Li to do this murder and silence.
Lin Yaochen's heartIt was cold. He guessed right, Lin Xiaotian really refused to let him go! These people were obviously following him and wanted to get rid of him completely in the back mountain!
"Lin Li, Lin Hu!" Lin Yaochen stood up. Although he was angry in his heart, his tone was extremely calm. He clenched the wooden stick in his hand, "What hatred do I, Lin Yaochen, have against you? Do you want to kill me again and again?"
"Huh, Lin Yaochen, you don't have to pretend to be pitiful!" Lin Li sneered, "You are a waste to begin with, and living is a waste of family resources! Moreover, you know too much!" There was something in his words, which obviously meant that Lin Yaochen might have noticed the secret of Lin Xiaotian's poison.
"Since you are stubborn, then go to hell!" Lin Li waved his hand, and together with Lin Hu and the guard, started throwing stones!
For a moment, rocks of all sizes hit Lin Yaochen like raindrops! The cliff is narrow and there is no place to hide. The forest Yaochen is left and right, and it is in a miserable state. He only has the cultivation level of a medicine disciple, and his body is far from recovered. How can he withstand the siege of three people?
"Bang!" A stone hit his shoulder, which suddenly became red and swollen.
"Ouch!" Another stone hit his calf, causing severe pain.
Lin Yaochen was retreating steadily and was about to be forced off the cliff! In the desperate situation, he suddenly caught a glimpse of the freshly dug curculigo plant at his feet!
Curculigo! Strengthen muscles and bones, remove cold and dampness! The system has said that curculigo has the effect of breaking obstacles!
"Fight!" A trace of madness flashed in Lin Yaochen's eyes. He no longer dodges, but instead bends down and grabs the curculigo plant. According to the method taught by the system to activate the medicinal power, he pours all the energy in his body into his palm and squeezes the curculigo plant hard!
"Break it for me!" Lin Yaochen roared, squeezing out the spicy juice and violently smearing it on his eye sockets, temples and the Tanzhong point on his chest! This is a method temporarily prompted by the system to use the warm and warm air of curculigo to stimulate acupuncture points and explode the potential in a short period of time. It has great side effects, but for him now, it is the only chance of survival!
【The medicinal properties of curculigo are stimulated! warn! The host body will bear a huge load! 】
A stream of hot air suddenly exploded from the part where the medicine penetrated, and instantly flowed throughout the body! Lin Yaochen felt that his eyes were red, his muscles were tensing, and his strength was gushing out like a flash flood! The arms that were originally sore and weak were now filled with explosive power!
"Get off!" Lin Yaochen roared up to the sky, his voice as hoarse as a beast. He suddenly picked up a sharp stone on the ground and spotted a larger stone hitting him. Not only did he not dodge, he rushed towards the stone and threw the stone with all his strength!
"Wha—!"
The stone was shot out like a crossbow arrow, carrying a fierce wind, and headed straight for Lin Li at the top of the cliff!
